premise: Clouds gather and everyone hurries home — Beaver to his lodge, Badger to his burrow, Bird to his nest — each worrying about Snail, who isn't hurrying at all, because his house is on his back.
inspiration: Zeus and the Tortoise (Aesop), where carrying your house is a punishment; turned: it's a gift, and Snail is the one who stays dry.
lesson: What makes you different can be exactly what you need.
learning: A snail carries its shell, its house, wherever it goes.

"Just in case," he said, and {beaver:go away} off he hurried to his lodge. {badger:enter} {badger:go to snail} Badger stopped by. {badger:face surprised} "Snail! Where's your house?" "Right here." [giggles] {snail:live laugh} "Right HERE!" said Snail. {bird:go away} Off flew Bird to his nest. {canvas:rain 0.8} {sfx:rain} Pitter-patter, down came the rain. {snail:live hide hold} Snail tucked himself into his shell. {sfx:taps} Tap, tap, went the rain on his roof. {canvas:rain stop} {canvas:clouds stop} {canvas:sunshine} When the rain stopped and the sun came out, {beaver:go back} {badger:go back} {bird:go back} {beaver:go to snail} {badger:go to snail} {bird:go to snail} back came his friends. {badger:face sad} [gently] "Snail? Are you wet?" {snail:live hide resume} Out peeked Snail, dry as a daisy. {snail:face happy} "I told you." {all:face happy} {all:wobble} [proudly] "My house goes wherever I go."

ja-JP.title: カタツムリくんの おうち

zh-TW.title: 蝸牛把家帶著走
zh-TW.text: {canvas:clouds 0.7}[rushed]灰灰的雲飄過來了。要下雨了！大家都趕快回家。{beaver:enter}河狸看到{snail:enter}蝸牛，{beaver:go to snail}{beaver:face surprised}停了下來：「蝸牛！你的家呢？」 {snail:face happy}{snail:live talk}「就在這裡呀。」 蝸牛說。可是河狸還是{beaver:live gnaw}咬了一根木棍，給牠當屋頂。「以防萬一嘛。」 牠說完，就{beaver:go away}趕快回自己的窩去了。{badger:enter}{badger:go to snail}獾也停了下來。{badger:face surprised}「蝸牛！你的家呢？」 「就在這裡呀。」 可是獾還是{badger:live dig}幫牠挖了一個小洞。「以防萬一嘛。」 牠說完，就{badger:go away}趕快回自己的地洞去了。{bird:enter}{bird:go to snail}小鳥咻地飛下來。{bird:face surprised}「蝸牛！你的家呢？」 [giggles]{snail:live laugh}「就、在、這、裡！」 蝸牛說。{bird:go away}小鳥飛回自己的鳥窩去了。{canvas:rain 0.8}{sfx:rain}滴滴答答，下雨了。{snail:live hide hold}蝸牛把身體縮進殼裡。{sfx:taps}叩叩，叩叩，雨點敲著牠的屋頂。{canvas:rain stop}{canvas:clouds stop}{canvas:sunshine}雨停了，太陽出來了，{beaver:go back}{badger:go back}{bird:go back}{beaver:go to snail}{badger:go to snail}{bird:go to snail}朋友們都回來了。{badger:face sad}[gently]「蝸牛？你淋濕了嗎？」 {snail:live hide resume}蝸牛探出頭來，全身乾乾爽爽的。{snail:face happy}「我就說吧。」 {all:face happy}{all:wobble}[proudly]「我走到哪裡，家就跟到哪裡。」
